capabilities: Display .msg and .eml files in a custom view with header, body and attachments sections
Search .msg and .eml content through an indexed search view styled like Obsidian's default search
Index .msg and .eml files in a database and re-check them on vault open or plugin load
Render image attachments with a toggle and save non-image attachments to a chosen vault folder
Embed message previews in editor and preview modes via wikilinks
motivation: People who must save important emails due to company retention policies (or who want to keep particular Outlook messages) need a way to find and open them inside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian cannot open Outlook .msg and .eml files and instead prompts to launch them in an external application, so saved emails cannot be read or searched inside the vault.

relations.evidence: You can install Ozan's Image in Editor plugin to view the embedded preview of your .msg or .eml files

summary: Viewer and indexed searcher for Outlook .msg and .eml files saved in the vault, with a custom message view for headers, body and attachments.
